_comment: Copy to search_config.json (gitignored) and fill in your own values. Keys starting with _ are ignored by the code. Duplicate list entries are removed automatically (case-insensitive).

titleMatch._includeKeywords_comment: A job title must contain at least one of these words/phrases. An empty list keeps every title.
titleMatch._wholeWords_comment: true = 'java' will NOT match 'javascript' and 'intern' will NOT match 'internal'. false = plain substring matching.

locations._accept_comment: A job passes if its location (or work mode) contains at least one of these places. Use 'Remote' to accept remote jobs. An empty list accepts every location. A job with no location at all is kept and flagged 'location unclear'.

filters._excludedEmployers_comment: Only useful for sources that return many companies (LinkedIn, aggregators). Harmless as an empty list for named-employer boards.
filters._descriptionExclusions_comment: Any match anywhere in the full job description rejects the job. To exclude only part of a product, list the specific phrase (e.g. 'Guidewire ClaimCenter' instead of 'Guidewire').
filters._preferredKeywords_comment: Not a filter. Each match adds 1 to a job's score so better matches can be ranked higher.

workArrangement._comment: Applies when a job is clearly remote, hybrid or on-site. Unclear jobs are kept and flagged.
